integrity_statement: A self-contained analytic proof and an independent Cartesian finite-check script accompany the finding. Numerical tests supplement rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Equal-span diagonals in exactly regular polygons; fixed integer or half-integer distance from diametral span; positive moment orders; compact critical-window parameters. Independent priority assessment absent.
title: Parity-resolved radial moment transitions for almost-diametral congruent polygon diagonals
